metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ib[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make `just test` fast under agent contention[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`just test` runs the same 27,978 tests in roughly half the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]CPU-seconds and a fraction of the wall clock it costs today, on an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]idle host and — especially — when several SASE agents run it [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]concurrently, with no test deleted, skipped, re-marked `slow`, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]weakened, and with no increase in host CPU or memory pressure.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]fast_test_suite_1.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/fast_test_suite_1.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-ib[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-ib/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Suite cost harness and committed baseline[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]baseline[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline: build the per-cause suite cost harness (idle vs CPU, app [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]boots, subprocess, parser, collection, worker RSS) on top of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing timings store, and commit the measured starting numbers every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]later phase is scored against.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Eliminate idle waiting in ACE TUI tests[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]idle[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]idle: replace the 20ms-granularity CPU-idle heuristic behind every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`pilot.pause()` and every bounded waiter with event-driven barriers, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TUI tests stop spending over half their wall clock asleep.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Amortize ACE app startup across tests[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]boot[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline, idle[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]boot: cut the cost of one ACE app boot and add a supported way for a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]group of tests to share one booted app, then migrate the heaviest TUI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]files onto it without weakening isolation.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cut cross-cutting per-test overhead outside the TUI[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]overhead[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]overhead: remove the repeated full-argparse parser builds, gettext [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lookups, YAML/config reparses, and avoidable CLI subprocess round-trips [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that the harness attributes across the non-TUI suite.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shrink worker memory and collection cost[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]footprint[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]footprint: reduce the per-worker collection time and the resident memory[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]each xdist worker holds and grows, which is what currently caps how many[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workers the host can afford.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fair worker allocation when agents run in parallel[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline, footprint[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate: make the host-global worker-token pool split fairly between [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]concurrent runs instead of granting the first arrival 28 tokens and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every later arrival the floor of 4.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Lock in the win with a cost regression gate[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after idle, boot, overhead, footprint, gate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: turn the harness into a standing regression gate with committed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]budgets, and document the new cost model for future contributors.[/#D7D7AF]
